component_api.get_all_component_properties:
X.get_all_component_properties(blueprint_path, component_name, include_inherited=True) -> Array[ComponentPropertyInfo]
Get all properties of a component in a blueprint.

Args:
    blueprint_path (str): Full path to the blueprint
    component_name (str): Name of the component
    include_inherited (bool): Whether to include inherited properties (default: true)

Returns:
    Array[ComponentPropertyInfo]: Array of property information Example: props = unreal.BlueprintService.get_all_component_properties("/Game/BP_Player", "Mesh") for prop in props: print(f"{prop.property_name}: {prop.property_type} = {prop.value}")
component_api.get_available_components:
X.get_available_components(search_filter="", max_results=50) -> Array[ComponentTypeInfo]
Get available component types that can be added to blueprints.
Use this to discover what components are available before adding them.

Args:
    search_filter (str): Optional filter to search by name (partial match, case-insensitive)
    max_results (int32): Maximum number of results to return (default 50)

Returns:
    Array[ComponentTypeInfo]: Array of available component types Example - Get all available components: types = unreal.BlueprintService.get_available_components() for t in types: print(f"{t.name} ({t.category})") Example - Search for mesh components: types = unreal.BlueprintService.get_available_components("Mesh")
component_api.get_component_hierarchy:
X.get_component_hierarchy(blueprint_path) -> Array[BlueprintComponentInfo]
Get the component hierarchy as a flat list with parent information.

Args:
    blueprint_path (str): Full path to the blueprint

Returns:
    Array[BlueprintComponentInfo]: Array of components with hierarchy information Example: hierarchy = unreal.BlueprintService.get_component_hierarchy("/Game/BP_Player_Test") for comp in hierarchy: indent = "  " if comp.attach_parent else "" print(f"{indent}{comp.component_name} ({comp.component_class})")
component_api.get_component_info:
X.get_component_info(component_type) -> ComponentDetailedInfo or None
Get detailed information about a component type.

Args:
    component_type (str): Component class name (e.g., "StaticMeshComponent")

Returns:
    ComponentDetailedInfo or None: True if successful Example: info = unreal.BlueprintService.get_component_info("StaticMeshComponent")  # ComponentDetailedInfo or None if info: print(f"Properties: {info.property_count}, Functions: {info.function_count}")

    out_info (ComponentDetailedInfo): Detailed component type information
component_api.get_component_property:
X.get_component_property(blueprint_path, component_name, property_name) -> str or None
Get a property value from a component in a blueprint.

Args:
    blueprint_path (str): Full path to the blueprint
    component_name (str): Name of the component
    property_name (str): Name of the property to get

Returns:
    str or None: True if successful Example: value = unreal.BlueprintService.get_component_property("/Game/BP_Player", "Mesh", "RelativeLocation")  # str or None

    out_value (str): Property value as a string
component_api.list_component_properties:
X.list_component_properties(blueprint_path, component_name, include_inherited=True) -> Array[ComponentPropertyInfo]
List all properties of a component in a blueprint.
This is an alias for GetAllComponentProperties with a more intuitive name.

Args:
    blueprint_path (str): Full path to the blueprint
    component_name (str): Name of the component
    include_inherited (bool): Whether to include inherited properties (default: true)

Returns:
    Array[ComponentPropertyInfo]: Array of property information Example: props = unreal.BlueprintService.list_component_properties("/Game/BP_Player", "Mesh") for prop in props: print(f"{prop.property_name}: {prop.property_type} = {prop.value}")
component_api.list_components:
X.list_components(blueprint_path) -> Array[BlueprintComponentInfo]
List all components in a blueprint.

Args:
    blueprint_path (str): Full path to the blueprint

Returns:
    Array[BlueprintComponentInfo]: Array of component information Example: comps = unreal.BlueprintService.list_components("/Game/BP_Player_Test")
